svg.aria-label: How a teamrig team grows. Day 1: you tell your lead what you want, and it hires api, web and docs. Week 2: tests and auth join; docs moves on when its job is done, and design takes its place. Month 2: the team becomes teams of teams, with a payments lead, a search lead, a mobile lead and a quality lead, each with its own members. Month 6: 8 teams and 33 members, with members joining and moving on, and you still talk to one lead.

g.text: You tell your lead what you want. It hires a team of three.
The work grows. New members join, and finished ones move on.
One team becomes teams of teams, each with its own lead.
8 teams and 33 members. You still talk to one lead.
